description.value: The Cache Creek Visitor Information Centre is the official tourism office for the Village of Cache Creek, a small community at the junction of Highways 1 and 97 in the Thompson region of BC. Situated at a major crossroads for trans-provincial travel, it serves as a natural stop for cyclists riding either the Trans-Canada or the Cariboo Highway corridor. As a municipal information office it would typically provide local area maps, attraction guides, and trip-planning assistance.
